form: # The online Area finance forms (/service/forms/): the Expense Reimbursement Request (form = expense) and the Annual Budget Request (form = budget). Each row is one choice, column or line of the official paper form, in the paper form's order (sort). label_en / label_es = the words on the form; hint_en / hint_es = the small grey help line under it.

# section: official = an official PDF or Word version offered for download (key = the document's id in data/documents/*.csv) | send = where the E-mail button sends the form (key = to or cc; committee = the committee or officer whose e-mail in committees.csv receives it) | line = a BUDGET LINE choice on the expense form | by = a REQUESTED BY choice | column = a column of the EXPENSE(S) table (code = its letter) | both / english / spanish / officer = the committee and officer choices of the budget form, in their groups | item = a line of ESTIMATED ANNUAL BUDGET EXPENSES (code = its number).

# kind: for line = other (adds a box to describe it); for by = district (adds a list, plus a Host District Position text box), officer or committee (each adds a list); for column = miles, mileage (miles x the mileage_rate in settings.csv) or amount; for item = amount (one dollar box), lines (description + dollars, rows to add or remove; rows = how many show at first; paper_rows = how many numbered lines the paper form has: the printed copy adds empty lines up to it while the page has room) or mileage (miles x mileage_rate). committee = a slug in committees.csv. Mileage rate, budget year and deadline: mileage_rate, budget_request_year and budget_request_deadline in settings.csv.

notes: The official form: "submit to MSCA09 Treasurer AP"
The official form: return to the Finance Committee Chair, cc the Treasurer A/P. The paper form prints finance@msca09aa.org; committees.csv has financechair@msca09aa.org.
